Waiting periods. When you first join, there is a waiting period of 182 days from the date your cover began. Treatment in the first 182 days is not covered. Treatment on day 182 or later is covered, subject to the usual limits.

[04_waiting_periods#2]
Waiting periods. How the days are counted. The date your cover began is day 0, so the waiting period is days 0 to 181 and cover starts on day 182, which is 182 days after your cover began. For example, if your cover began on 1 March 2026, treatment on 29 August 2026 (day 181) is not covered and treatment on 30 August 2026 (day 182) is covered.
